messages:
kate-support: FYI incoming customer escalation (ACME Prod). After last night's model swap to model:v7.2 we see function-call responses with missing/opaque args and silent fallback to the default tool. Customer trace: trace_id=trc_8a9f3c. They reported 502-style schema errors and incorrect tool chosen.
micah: can you paste a sample request/response from the customer? also which deployment did they hit (hosted/dedicated/vpc)?
kate-support: pasted below (redacted). Hosted region us-west-2, account acme-inc, path /v1/exec. Request: ```{"model":"v7.2","input":"summarize","tools":[{"id":"kb.search","schema":{"q":"string"}}],"tool_args":{"q":"pricing plans"}}``` Response body: ```{"tool_call":{"name":"kb.search","args":"{\"query\":\"pricing plans\"}"},"result":{"status":"error","error":"schema_mismatch: required field 'q' missing"}}``` Customer says function args looked like a single-stringified JSON in `args` and the model picked `kb.search` sometimes but other times fell back to `legacy_kb` with empty args.
anya: that stringified-args pattern looks like the model emitted a JSON string instead of structured object — could be tokenizer/decoder change in v7.2's system prompt handling. Any canary metrics?
jordan: deployment health: canary pool for v7.2 (canary-3 nodes) shows ~6.8% tool-call schema rejects and a small spike in 5xx on exec gateway around 03:10 UTC. Full rollout started at 02:50 UTC. Logs attached: `exec-gw: 502 validateToolArgs failed: missing q` across requests with same trace prefix.
sre-bot: Deployment event: model:v7.2 rollout started 2026-03-16T02:50:12Z. Canary nodes: canary-3 (3/10 traffic). Autoscaler note: no scale events.
micah: thanks. Two possible lanes: 1) rollback to v7.1 for hosted while we triage; 2) hotfix to parsing layer that unwraps stringified JSON in tool args. Which has lower blast radius?
anya: if root cause is model change in prompt output shape, hotfix might be brittle. Safer short-term is rollback to v7.1 while we fix canonical emit formatting and add stricter schema validation with auto-unwrapping for legacy string args.
jordan: rollback cost: we can flip routing within 3m and keep canary active to validate v7.1 behavior. I'll prepare rollback runbook. Need approval from product/infra.
kate-support: customer wants immediate mitigation. They reported production impact on billing workflows (some invoices failed). Please escalate.
micah: assigning to micah (eng-runtime) and anya (ml-infra). micah - can you own rollback? anya - lead investigation for decoding change. I'll open incident ticket and ping infra-sre.
micah: initiating rollback now — switching default routing back to model:v7.1 for acme-inc and global hosted buckets. Will post when complete.
sre-bot: Routing change: traffic for acme-inc -> model:v7.1 executed at 2026-03-16T03:02:09Z. Change id rch_5f2b.
jordan: monitoring: error rate for tool schema rejects dropped from 6.8% to 0.3% in 5m window after rollback for acme-inc. Gateway 5xx also returned to baseline.
kate-support: relaying to customer: they confirmed reduction in failures for the last 10 minutes. They asked for root cause and timeline for fix.
anya: next steps: 1) reproduce locally with v7.2 using the customer's prompt+tools; 2) add a unit test in the emit-parser to detect stringified-JSON args and auto-coerce; 3) add a canary check that fails rollout if tool args are non-object >0.5% of calls. I'll aim for an initial patch in next 24h.
micah: thanks. I'll leave v7.2 rollout paused. If anyone sees persistent edge hits, tag me.
kate-support: created INC-2026-842 with attachments and customer logs. Notifying account exec. :loud_sound:
anya: noted. I'll push a reproduction and a proposed PR description in the eng-ml channel.
micah: marking owner; closing from support side once customer OKs. :thumbsup:
kate-support: customer confirmed recovery, wants postmortem and ETA. We'll keep thread open for the PR and postmortem link.
